evals.prompt: I need a DITA dataset for our AEM Guides training pipeline. We're covering Docker container management — topics should include creating containers, networking between containers, volumes, docker-compose, and health checks. We want a deep hierarchy structure, maybe 3-4 levels deep. Can you kick that off?
evals.expected_output: Claude should: (1) identify 'deep_hierarchy' as the recipe, (2) extract a specific subject like 'Docker container management: networking, volumes, docker-compose, health checks', (3) suggest depth=4 and children_per_level=3-4 in config, (4) provide a clear pre-flight explanation of what will be generated, (5) call create_job with all required fields populated

assertions.name: identifies_deep_hierarchy_recipe
assertions.description: Claude selects deep_hierarchy as the recipe_type

assertions.name: specific_subject_field
assertions.description: The subject field is specific and domain-accurate, mentioning Docker concepts

assertions.name: preflight_explanation_given
assertions.description: Claude explains what will be generated before calling create_job

assertions.name: create_job_called
assertions.description: Claude calls create_job with recipe_type, subject, and config

evals.prompt: Hey, I've got this Jira ticket AG-2091 that's asking for better test coverage of DITA conref patterns — specifically how we handle conref on note, warning, and hazardstatement elements. Can you use that ticket to generate a dataset?
evals.expected_output: Claude should: (1) call search_jira_issues to look up AG-2091, (2) map the conref/note/warning content to 'conref_pack' or 'dita_conref_keyref_dataset_recipe', (3) set jira_id='AG-2091' on the create_job call, (4) set subject focused on DITA note/warning/hazardstatement conref patterns, (5) include the JIRA context in prompt_text

assertions.name: searches_jira_ticket
assertions.description: Claude calls search_jira_issues with AG-2091 or equivalent lookup

assertions.name: appropriate_conref_recipe
assertions.description: Recipe chosen is conref_pack, dita_conref_keyref_dataset_recipe, or similarly conref-focused

assertions.name: subject_mentions_note_elements
assertions.description: The subject or prompt_text references note/warning/hazardstatement elements

evals.prompt: Can you create task topics for AEM Guides authoring workflows? I need topics covering: creating a DITA map, adding topic references, configuring conditional content with DITAVAL, publishing to native PDF, and managing keydefs. Make it about 15 topics.
evals.expected_output: Claude should: (1) select 'task_topics' as the recipe, (2) set a specific subject like 'AEM Guides authoring: DITA maps, topicrefs, DITAVAL, native PDF, keydefs', (3) set topic_count=15 in config (within the cap of 50), (4) include the workflow items in prompt_text, (5) give a pre-flight summary before calling create_job

assertions.name: selects_task_topics_recipe
assertions.description: Claude selects task_topics as the recipe_type

assertions.name: topic_count_within_caps
assertions.description: topic_count is set to 15 (or close), not exceeding 50

assertions.name: subject_specific_to_aem_guides
assertions.description: Subject field mentions AEM Guides and specific workflow items (DITAVAL, native PDF, keydefs, etc.)

assertions.name: workflow_items_in_prompt_text
assertions.description: prompt_text captures the specific workflows listed by the user

assertions.name: preflight_explanation_given
assertions.description: Claude explains what 15 task topics will look like before creating the job
